newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re 95/96 net profit up 83.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re 95/96 net profit up 83.1 pct.

text.p: MUNICH, Nov 11, Reuter - Business year ended June 30 1996
(in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Gp earnings from capital investments 7,935 vs 7,322
Group earnings per share 140 vs 67.60 dmk
GP earnings from ord activities 1,134 vs 726

NOTE - Full name of the German insurer is Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG, the world's largest reinsurance group, known as Munich Re. Underwriting earnings from the previous period have been revised to reflect a new accounting method, which shifts certain administrative costs to the underwriting account. The earnings per share figure for 1994/1995 has also been revised to reflect a capital increase in November 1995.
In a statement, Munich Re said the rise in profits was due to a strong improvement in its underwriting earnings
